news.title: No cloud, no GPUs, no problem: Liquid AI's new model LFM2.5-2.6B brings powerful AI agents to devices as small as a Raspberry Pi

news.summary: Liquid AI has released a new open-weight language model called LFM2.5-2.6B that can run on local hardware, including smartphones, laptops, and a Raspberry Pi.
